title: Current FlyLo continuation baseline
summary: The durable ooRexx/Wire UI application baseline remains flylo_v0.4.11.zip. A separate MVS 3.8J/TK5 backend-validation line now qualifies the airline semantics on ED209ZZ; it does not silently replace or renumber the application release.
invariants: Do not regress to multi-terminal or Python-sidecar startup for the website.
Booking/inventory/passenger state is durable across launcher restarts.
passengerCount is numeric traveller count; passengers is the passenger-record collection.
Stable passenger identities use PAX-... semantic IDs.
The browser, Grok and Wire UI do not own booking/inventory/payment/accounting authority.
The MVS backend must be independently testable without the browser or Terminal Machine history features.
Do not conflate the ooRexx application release version with the MVS backend qualification stream.

provenance.claim: Separate clean-room MVS backend qualification programme.
